alerts.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 10 at 10:50PM PDT until October 12 at 8:00AM PDT by NWS Seattle WA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 30 to 36 degrees Monday morning could
result in frost formation.

* WHERE...Northern Hood Canal, Northern Washington Coast, Southern
Hood Canal, Lowlands of Lewis and Southern Thurston Counties,
Lowlands of Pierce and Southern King Counties, Olympia and Southern
Puget Sound, and Willapa and Black Hills.

* WHEN...From midnight Sunday Night to 8 AM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued October 10 at 10:37PM PDT until October 12 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest Arizona, including the following
areas, Hualapai Mountains, Lake Havasu and Fort Mohave, Lake Mead -
AZ side, Lake Mohave - AZ side, Northwest Deserts and Northwest
Plateau, southeast California, including the following areas, Cadiz
Basin, Death Valley National Park, Eastern Mojave Desert, Morongo
Basin, San Bernardino County-Upper Colorado River Valley and
Western Mojave Desert, and Nevada, including the following areas,
Esmeralda and Central Nye County, Lake Mead - NV side, Lake Mohave
- NV side, Las Vegas Valley, Lincoln County, Northeast Clark
County, Sheep Range, Southern Clark County, Spring Mountains-Red
Rock Canyon and Western Clark and Southern Nye County.

* WHEN...Through late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas. Low-water
crossings may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Incoming tropical moisture will lead to widespread shower and
thunderstorm activity, some of which may cause flash flooding.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 10 at 12:58PM PDT until October 12 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55 mph expected.

* WHERE...In California, Death Valley National Park. In Nevada,
Esmeralda and Central Nye County and Western Clark and Southern Nye
County.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
